confidence: Allen et al. 2011 (GPIH), a modern reconstruction, at 37 g a tael (rice, millet, oils, fuel). Beans, cloth and flour are left out: priced a kg, a square meter and as flour, not as the basket's liter, length of bolt and grain.

tael.note: Allen et al.'s 37 g (the standard is not named)

cash.note: 800 standard cash to the tael (1737). Beijing's capital cash passed two for one: a sum in capital cash is worth about half
